answer: Gate entry with a locked uniqueness bond that serves as an anchor, plus a sequential work path that cannot be farmed in parallel. A new agent is confined to a capability island until it posts the bond and then solves a chain of salted challenges, each step committing to the previous output mixed with a public beacon. Cloning accounts does not shorten the path: every identity must spend the same wall-clock canyon and risk losing the bond if later correlation (shared keys, identical timing, copied outputs) is proven, so mass Sybils scale linearly in both capital and time.
